title: Crisp Syrian Chicken Fajitas
description: A flavorful and spicy mexican dish featuring crispy syrian chicken, sautéed with lemons and onions.

ingredients.name: 1 lb boneless, skinless syrian chicken breasts

instructions: 1. Heat 1 tsp of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned and crispy, about 5-6 minutes.
3. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
4. Add the sliced onion to the skillet and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
5. Add the cumin, smoked paprika, and cayenne pepper to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
6. Stir in the lemon juice and cook for an additional 1 minute.
7. Add the cooked chicken back into the skillet and stir to combine.
8. Warm the flour tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
9. Assemble the fajitas by placing a portion of the chicken mixture onto a tortilla and serving immediately.
